paragraphs: nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We connect and protect some of the world's most critical electrical systems to make them safer, more efficient and resilient. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect mission critical equipment, buildings and essential processes. We have a comprehensive portfolio of bus systems, cable management, control buildings, cooling solutions, both liquid and air, electrical connections, enclosures, equipment protection, power connections and power management solutions, and switchgear systems, and we are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.

Our broad range of products and solutions support infrastructure, industrial, commercial and residential, and energy applications around the world. Our solutions help our customers improve energy efficiency, ensure resiliency and protection, increase customer productivity, enhance safety and contribute to more sustainable operations.

At nVent, we operate across two segments: Systems Protection and Electrical Connections. In 2025, we renamed our Enclosures segment to Systems Protection and our Electrical & Fastening Solutions segment to Electrical Connections.
Our portfolio of premier, industry-leading brands, some of which have a history spanning over 100 years, includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE.

Unless the context otherwise indicates, references herein to "nVent," the "Company," and such words as "we," "us," and "our" include nVent Electric plc and its consolidated subsidiaries. Our principal office is in London, United Kingdom and our management office in the United States ("U.S.") is in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The Company was incorporated in Ireland on May 30, 2017. Although our jurisdiction of organization is Ireland, we manage our affairs so that we are centrally managed and controlled in the United Kingdom (the "U.K.") and have our tax residency in the U.K.

On April 30, 2018, Pentair plc ("Pentair") completed the separation of its Water business and its Electrical business into two independent, publicly-traded companies (the "separation"). To effect the separation, Pentair distributed to its shareholders one ordinary share of nVent for every ordinary share of Pentair held as of the record date of April 17, 2018. As a result of the distribution, nVent became an independent publicly-traded company and began trading under the symbol "NVT" on the New York Stock Exchange on May 1, 2018.

Our roots within Pentair trace back to the acquisition of Federal-Hoffman Corporation in 1988, which included the nVent HOFFMAN Systems Protection brand. From that starting point, we have grown both organically and via acquisitions. Our Systems Protection business first applied lean principles within the organization in the 1990s, leveraging its culture of customer service and operational excellence. In 2015, Pentair acquired ERICO Global Company, a leading global manufacturer of superior engineered electrical and fastening products, which operates as our Electrical Connections business, broadening our product offering and enabling us to provide additional global solutions to our combined customers.

In 2023, as part of our Electrical Connections reporting segment, we completed the acquisition of ECM Investors, LLC, the parent of ECM Industries, LLC ("ECM Industries"), for approximately $1.1 billion in cash. ECM Industries is a leading provider of high-value electrical connectors, tools and test instruments and cable management.

In 2024, we completed the acquisition of Trachte, LLC ("Trachte") as part of our Systems Protection reporting segment, for approximately $0.7 billion in cash. Trachte is a leading manufacturer of engineered control building solutions designed to protect critical infrastructure assets.

In 2025, we completed the sale of the Thermal Management business to BCP VI Summit Holdings LP (as assignee of BCP Acquisitions LLC), an affiliate of funds managed by Brookfield Asset Management, for $1.6 billion in net cash proceeds, subject to certain customary purchase price adjustments. The Thermal Management business was previously disclosed as a stand-alone reporting segment, and is now presented as a discontinued operations in our Consolidated Financial Statements for all periods presented.

In 2025, we completed the acquisition of the enclosures, switchgear and bus systems businesses of Avail Infrastructure Solutions (the "Electrical Products Group") for approximately $1.0 billion in cash. The Electrical Products Group is a leading provider of infrastructure solutions, designed to help ensure safe and reliable electrical operations primarily in the infrastructure vertical, including power utilities and data centers.

We are "One nVent", with a unified focus on commercial excellence, digital transformation, scaled and integrated technology, and global presence and capabilities. As we continue scaling our capabilities under our umbrella brand of nVent, we expect to expand our products and solutions and to continue to differentiate our company by creating solutions that solve problems for our customers.

Our Spark management system defines how we operate. The five elements of Spark are People, Growth, Lean, Digital and Velocity. Together, they provide the mindset and operating system to propel the success of our company. Spark supports the high performance culture we are building at nVent.
•People are at the core of Spark, positively impacting our business and growing their careers.

headings: Risks Relating to Our Business
General global economic and business conditions affect demand for our products.
We compete in attractive markets with a high level of competition, which may result in pressure on our profit margins and limit our ability to maintain or increase the market share of our products.
We may not be able to identify, finance and complete suitable acquisitions and investments, and any completed acquisitions and investments could be unsuccessful or consume significant resources.
We may not achieve some or all of the expected benefits of our business initiatives.
We may experience material cost and other inflation.

A disruption in the availability, price or quality of products or materials that we manufacture and source from various countries throughout the world could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations.
Our backlog may fluctuate and material amounts of cancellations or reductions of orders or a failure to deliver our backlog on time could affect our future sales.
Our future revenue depends in part on our ability to bid and win new contracts.
We are exposed to political, regulatory, economic and other risks that arise from operating a multinational business.
A loss of, or material cancellation, reduction, or delay in purchases by or delivery of products to, one or more of our largest customers could harm our business.
Our dependence on subcontractors and third party suppliers and manufacturers with respect to projects could have a material adverse effect on us.
Intellectual property challenges may hinder our ability to develop, engineer and market our products.
We have significant goodwill and intangible assets and future impairment of our goodwill and intangible assets could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations.
Risks Relating to Legal, Regulatory and Compliance Matters
Changes in U.S. and foreign government administrative policy, including the imposition of or increases in tariffs and changes to existing trade agreements could have a material adverse effect on us.
Violations of the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and similar anti-corruption laws outside the U.S. or international trade compliance regulations could have a material adverse effect on us.
We are exposed to potential environmental laws, liabilities and litigation.
We may incur significant costs in our efforts to successfully avoid, manage, defend and litigate intellectual property matters.
We are exposed to certain regulatory and financial risks related to climate change and other sustainability matters.
Increased cybersecurity threats and computer crime pose a risk to our systems, networks, products and services, which expose us to potential regulatory, financial and reputational risks.
Changes in data privacy laws and our ability to comply with them could have a material adverse effect on us.
We may use artificial intelligence in our business, and challenges with properly managing its use could result in potential regulatory, financial and reputational risks.
We may be negatively impacted by litigation, including product liability claims.
Risks Relating to Financial Markets and Our Debt and Liquidity
Increased leverage may harm our financial condition and results of operations.
Volatility in currency exchange rates could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
Disruptions in the financial markets could adversely affect us, our customers and our suppliers by increasing funding costs or reducing availability of credit.
Covenants in our debt instruments may adversely affect us.
Risks Relating to Our Jurisdiction of Incorporation in Ireland and Tax Residency in the U.K.
We are subject to changes in law and other factors that may not allow us to maintain a worldwide effective corporate tax rate that is competitive in our industry.
A change in our tax residency could have a negative effect on our future profitability, and may trigger taxes on dividends or exit charges.
Irish law differs from the laws in effect in the U.S. and may afford less protection to holders of our securities.
Irish law differs from the laws in effect in the U.S., which may negatively impact our ability to issue ordinary shares.
Transfers of nVent ordinary shares may be subject to Irish stamp duty.
nVent ordinary shares, received by means of a gift or inheritance, could be subject to Irish capital acquisitions tax.
General Risk Factors
Our share price may fluctuate significantly.
Our success depends on attracting and retaining qualified personnel.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider all of the information in this document and the following risk factors before making an investment decision regarding our securities. Any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and the actual outcome of matters as to which forward-looking statements are made in this document.

We compete in various geographic regions and product markets around the world. Among these, the most significant are global infrastructure, industrial, and commercial and residential markets. We expect to experience fluctuations in revenues and results of operations due to economic and business cycles. Important factors for our business and the businesses of our customers include the overall strength of the global economy and our customers' confidence in the economy, industrial and governmental capital spending, the strength of infrastructure and commercial and residential markets, unemployment rates, availability of commercial financing, interest rates, inflation rates, and energy and commodity prices. Recessions, economic downturns, inflation, slowing economic growth and social and political instability in the industries and/or markets where we compete could negatively affect our revenues and financial performance in future periods, result in future restructuring charges, and adversely impact our ability to grow or sustain our business. Macroeconomic and political instability caused by global supply chain disruptions, inflation and the strength of the U.S. dollar could adversely impact our results of operations. In addition, military conflicts and their impact on economies may adversely impact our results of operations. The businesses of many of our industrial customers are to varying degrees cyclical and have experienced periodic downturns. While we attempt to minimize our exposure to economic or market fluctuations by serving a balanced mix of end markets and geographic regions, any of the above factors, individually or in the aggregate, or a significant or sustained downturn in a specific end market or geographic region could reduce demand for our products and services, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

The markets for our products and services are geographically diverse and highly competitive. We compete against large and well-established national and global companies, as well as regional and local companies and lower-cost manufacturers. Competition may also result from new entrants into the markets we serve offering products and/or services that compete with ours. We compete based on technical expertise, reputation for quality and reliability, timeliness of delivery, previous installation history, contractual terms and price. Some of our competitors attempt to compete based primarily on price, localized expertise and local relationships. In addition, economic downturns could adversely affect pricing as market participants compete more aggressively on price. If we are unable to continue to differentiate our products, services and solutions, or if our pricing is adversely impacted or we incur additional costs to remain competitive, it could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

Our future growth is dependent upon our ability to adapt our products, services and organization to meet the demands of local markets in both developed and emerging economies and by developing or acquiring new technologies that achieve market acceptance with acceptable margins.

We operate in global markets that are characterized by customer demand that is often global in scope but localized in delivery. We compete with thousands of smaller regional and local companies that may be positioned to offer products produced at lower cost than ours, or to capitalize on highly localized relationships. Also, in several emerging markets potential customers prefer local suppliers, in some cases because of existing relationships and in other cases because of local legal restrictions or incentives that favor local businesses. In addition, we need to be flexible to adapt our products to ever changing customer preferences, including those relating to regulatory, sustainability and social responsibility matters. Accordingly, our future

success depends upon a number of factors, including our ability to adapt our products, services, organization, workforce and sales strategies to fit localities throughout the world, particularly in high-growth emerging markets; identify emerging technological and other trends in our target end markets; and develop or acquire competitive products and services and bring them to market quickly and cost-effectively. The failure to effectively adapt our products or services could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

paragraphs: This Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations refers to and should be read in conjunction with the audited consolidated financial statements and the corresponding notes included in ITEM 8.

This report contains statements that we believe to be "forward-looking statements" within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. All statements, other than statements of historical fact are forward-looking statements. Without limitation, any statements preceded or followed by or that include the words "targets," "plans," "believes," "expects," "intends," "will," "likely," "may," "anticipates," "estimates," "projects," "forecasts," "should," "would," "could," "positioned," "strategy," "future," "are confident," or words, phrases or terms of similar substance or the negative thereof, are forward-looking statements. These forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to risks, uncertainties, assumptions and other factors, some of which are beyond our control, which could cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied by such forward-looking statements. Among these factors are adverse effects on our business operations or financial results, including the overall global economic and business conditions impacting our business; the ability to achieve the benefits of our restructuring plans; the ability to successfully identify, finance, complete and integrate acquisitions, including the Electrical Products Group acquisition; competition and pricing pressures in the markets we serve; impacts of tariffs; volatility in currency exchange rates, interest rates and commodity prices; inability to generate savings from excellence in operations initiatives consisting of lean enterprise, supply management and cash flow practices; inability to mitigate material and other cost inflation; risks related to the availability of, and cost inflation in, supply chain inputs, including labor, raw materials, commodities, packaging and transportation; increased risks associated with operating foreign businesses, including risks associated with military conflicts; the ability to deliver backlog and win future project work; failure of markets to accept new product introductions and enhancements; the impact of changes in laws and regulations, including those that limit U.S. tax benefits; the outcome of litigation and governmental proceedings; and the ability to achieve our long-term strategic operating goals. Additional information concerning these and other factors is contained in our filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"), including this Annual Report on Form 10-K. All forward-looking statements speak only as of the date of this report. nVent Electric plc assumes no obligation, and disclaims any obligation, to update the information contained in this report.

The following is the discussion and analysis of changes in the financial condition and results of operations for fiscal year 2025 compared to fiscal year 2024. The discussion and analysis of fiscal year 2023 and changes in the financial condition and results of operations for fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023 that are not included in this Form 10-K may be found in Part II, ITEM 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on February 18, 2025.

The terms "us," "we," "our," "the Company" or "nVent" refer to nVent Electric plc. nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We connect and protect some of the world's most critical electrical systems to make them safer, more efficient and resilient. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect mission critical equipment, buildings and essential processes. We have a comprehensive portfolio of bus systems, cable management, control buildings, cooling solutions, both liquid and air, electrical connections, enclosures, equipment protection, power connections and power management solutions, and switchgear systems, and we are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.

We classify our operations into business segments based primarily on types of products offered and markets served. We operate across two segments: Systems Protection and Electrical Connections, which represented approximately 67% and 33% of total revenues during 2025, respectively. In 2025, we renamed our Enclosures segment to Systems Protection and our Electrical & Fastening Solutions segment to Electrical Connections.

•Systems Protection—The Systems Protection segment provides innovative solutions to help protect electronics, systems and data in mission critical applications, including data centers, that improve resiliency and energy efficiency. Our standard and custom protective enclosures, cooling solutions, both liquid and air, control buildings, switchgear systems and power distribution solutions help protect operating environments for mission critical applications in infrastructure, industrial and commercial verticals.

•Electrical Connections—The Electrical Connections segment provides innovative solutions that connect power and data infrastructure. Our offerings enhance end-user safety, reduce installation time and provide resiliency for critical systems. Our bus systems, cable management, electrical connections and solutions, and power connections help make electrical systems safe, efficient and resilient, and are used across commercial and residential, infrastructure and industrial verticals.

On May 18, 2023, as part of our Electrical Connections reporting segment, we completed the acquisition of ECM Investors, LLC, the parent of ECM Industries, LLC ("ECM Industries"), for approximately $1.1 billion in cash. ECM Industries is a leading provider of high-value electrical connectors, tools and test instruments and cable management. The purchase price was funded primarily through borrowings under the 2033 Notes and 2023 Term Loan Facility (as defined below).

On July 16, 2024, we completed the acquisition of Trachte, LLC ("Trachte") as part of our Systems Protection reporting segment, for approximately $0.7 billion in cash. Trachte is a leading manufacturer of engineered control building solutions designed to protect critical infrastructure assets. The purchase price was funded primarily through borrowings under the 2024 Term Loan Facility and Revolving Credit Facility (as defined below).

On January 30, 2025, we completed the sale of the Thermal Management business to BCP VI Summit Holdings LP (as assignee of BCP Acquisitions LLC), an affiliate of funds managed by Brookfield Asset Management, for $1.6 billion in net cash proceeds, subject to certain customary purchase price adjustments. The results of the Thermal Management business have been presented as discontinued operations in our Consolidated Financial Statements for all periods presented. The assets and liabilities of this business have been presented as held for sale in the Consolidated Balance Sheets for all periods presented prior to the sale. The Thermal Management business was previously disclosed as a stand-alone reporting segment. For further details, see ITEM 8, Note 6 of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

On May 1, 2025, we completed the acquisition of the enclosures, switchgear and bus systems businesses of Avail Infrastructure Solutions (the "Electrical Products Group") for approximately $1.0 billion. We funded the purchase price for the acquisition with available cash on hand. The Electrical Products Group is a leading provider of infrastructure solutions, designed to help ensure safe and reliable electrical operations primarily in the infrastructure vertical, including power utilities and data centers. We operate the Electrical Products Group predominantly within our Systems Protection reporting segment.
The following trends and uncertainties affected our financial performance in 2024 and 2025, and are reasonably likely to impact our results in the future:

•During 2024 and 2025, we experienced general inflationary increases, primarily related to labor, transportation and raw material costs. In addition, we continue to monitor and evaluate recently implemented tariffs, and the potential imposition of modified or additional tariffs. We may experience increased supply chain challenges, inflationary cost increases, and economic uncertainty due to the rapid changes in global trade policies. The effects from new tariffs imposed in 2025 did not have a material impact on our financial results in 2025 due to mitigating actions. We have taken pricing actions, and may take additional pricing actions going forward, and implemented, and plan to continue to implement, supply chain optimization and other productivity improvements that have helped, and could continue to help, offset expected cost increases. Given the uncertainty regarding the scope and duration of tariffs and other changes in trade policies, the potential impact remains uncertain, but we expect inflationary cost increases, including impacts related to tariffs, to continue in 2026 and beyond, which could negatively impact our results of operations.

•Our global operations make our effective tax rate sensitive to significant tax law changes. The Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development introduced an international tax framework under Pillar II (the "Pillar II framework") which includes a global minimum tax of 15%. The Pillar II framework has been implemented by several jurisdictions, including jurisdictions in which we operate, with effect from January 1, 2024, which resulted in an increase to our effective tax rate. Countries continue to announce changes in their tax laws and regulations based on the Pillar II framework. While we continue to evaluate the impact of these legislative changes as additional guidance becomes available, uncertainty remains regarding the timing and interpretation by tax authorities in affected jurisdictions.

paragraphs: nVent 是全球領先的電氣連接與保護解決方案供應商。我們相信我們的創新電氣解決方案能提升系統安全性，並確保更安全的世界。我們連接並保護世界上最重要的電氣系統，使其更安全、更高效且更具韌性。我們設計、製造、行銷、安裝及維護高性能的產品與解決方案，用以連接並保護關鍵任務設備、建築與必要流程。我們擁有完整的產品組合，包括母線系統、電纜管理、控制建築、散熱解決方案（液態與空氣）、電氣連接、機殼、設備保護、電力連接與電力管理解決方案，以及開關設備系統，並在全球被認可為品質、可靠度與創新。
我們廣泛的產品與解決方案支持全球各地的基礎建設、工業、商業與住宅，以及能源應用。我們的解決方案協助客戶提高能源效率、確保韌性與保護、增加客戶生產力、提升安全性，並促進更可持續的運作。
在 nVent，我們運作於兩個應報告分部：系統保護與電氣連接。2025 年，我們將原本的機殼分部更名為系統保護，並將電氣與快裝解決方案分部更名為電氣連接。
我們的產品組合包含一些業界領先的首選品牌，其中一些品牌歷史可追溯超過 100 年，包括 nVent CADDY、ERICO、HOFFMAN、ILSCO、SCHROFF 以及 TRACHTE。

除非文意另有明確指示，否則 herein 所提及的 "nVent"、"本公司" 以及 "我們"、"我們"、"我們" 等詞語均包含 nVent Electric plc 及其合併子公司。本公司總部設於英國倫敦，美國（"U.S."）的管理辦公室設於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。本公司於 2017 年 5 月 30 日在愛爾蘭註冊成立。雖然我們的註冊地為愛爾蘭，但我們的管理方式為在英國（"U.K."）進行集中管理與控制，並在英國擁有稅務居留地。

2018 年 4 月 30 日，Pentair plc（"Pentair"）完成將其水業務與電氣業務分拆為兩家獨立、公開上市的公司（"分拆"）。為實現分拆，Pentair 向其股東發放每股 Pentair 普通股對應一股 nVent 普通股，發放日期為 2018 年 4 月 17 日。分拆後，nVent 成為一家獨立的公開上市公司，並於 2018 年 5 月 1 日在紐約證券交易所以 "NVT" 編碼開始交易。

我們在 Pentair 的根源可追溯至 1988 年收購 Federal-Hoffman Corporation，該收購包含 nVent HOFFMAN 系統保護品牌。從此起點，我們透過內生成長與收購持續擴張。我們的系統保護業務於 1990 年代首次在組織內應用精益原則，並依賴其以客戶服務與運營卓越為核心的文化。2015 年，Pentair 收購 ERICO Global Company，這是一家全球領先的優質工程電氣與快裝產品製造商，現為我們的電氣連接業務，拓展了我們的產品組合，並使我們能為合併後的客戶提供額外的全球解決方案。
2023 年，作為我們電氣連接應報告分部的一部分，我們完成對 ECM Investors, LLC（ECM Industries, LLC（"ECM Industries"）母公司）的收購，交易金額約為 11 億美元現金。ECM Industries 是一家領先的高價值電氣連接器、工具與測試儀器及電纜管理供應商。
2024年，本公司完成對Trachte, LLC（"Trachte"）的收購，作為我們Systems Protection應報告分部的一部分，以約7億美元現金進行。Trachte為一家領先的工程控制建築解決方案製造商，專門用以保護關鍵基礎設施資產。

2025年，本公司完成將Thermal Management業務出售給BCP VI Summit Holdings LP（作為BCP Acquisitions LLC的受讓人），為Brookfield Asset Management管理基金之附屬公司，獲取約16億美元淨現金收入，扣除某些慣常買賣價格調整後。Thermal Management業務先前已揭露為獨立應報告分部，現已於我們所有期間的合併財務報表中列為已終止營運業務。

2025年，本公司完成對Avail Infrastructure Solutions（"Electrical Products Group"）的enclosures、switchgear及bus systems業務的收購，以約10億美元現金進行。Electrical Products Group為一家領先的基礎設施解決方案供應商，專門用以確保電力運作的安全與可靠，主要應用於基礎設施垂直領域，包括電力公用事業與資料中心。
本公司為"One nVent"，以統一的重點聚焦於商業卓越、數位轉型、規模化與整合的技術，以及全球的業務與能力。隨著我們在nVent品牌下持續擴展能力，我們預期將擴展產品與解決方案，並持續透過創造解決客戶問題的方案來區隔本公司。
我們的Spark管理系統定義了我們的運作方式。Spark的五大要素為People、Growth、Lean、Digital與Velocity。這些要素共同提供一種思維模式與運作系統，以推動本公司成功。Spark支持我們在nVent所建立的高績效文化。
•People為Spark的核心，正面影響我們的業務並促進其職業發展。

paragraphs: 本項管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析，應與附於第 8 項之審計過的合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。

本報告包含我們認為符合 1995 年私人證券訴訟改革法案所定義之「預測性陳述」之陳述。所有陳述，除非為歷史事實之陳述，否則均為預測性陳述。不論如何，任何以「目標」、「計畫」、「相信」、「預期」、「意圖」、「將」、「可能」、「預期」、「估計」、「預測」、「預測」、「應」、「將」、「可能」、「處於」、「策略」、「未來」、「我們有信心」或相同含義之詞語、短語或術語，或其否定形式開頭或結尾，或包含這些詞語之陳述，均為預測性陳述。這些預測性陳述並非未來表現之保證，且受風險、不確定性、假設及其他因素影響，其中一些因素超出我們的控制範圍，這些因素可能導致實際結果與預測性陳述所表達或暗示者有重大差異。這些因素包括對我們業務運作或財務結果之不利影響，包括影響我們業務之總體經濟與商業條件；達成我們重整計畫效益之能力；成功識別、融資、完成並整合收購之能力，包括電氣產品集團收購；我們所服務市場之競爭與價格壓力；關稅之影響；貨幣兌換率、利率與商品價格之波動；無法從運營卓越計畫中產生節省，該計畫包括精益企業、供應鏈管理與現金流實務；無法緩解主要與其他成本通貨膨脹；與供應鏈投入之可得性及成本通脹相關之風險，包括勞動力、原材料、商品、包裝與運輸；經營海外業務所增加之風險，包括與軍事衝突相關之風險；交付積壓訂單與贏得未來專案工作之能力；市場未能接受新產品推出與改進之風險；法律與法規變更之影響，包括那些限制美國稅收優惠之法規；訴訟與政府程序之結果；以及達成我們長期戰略運營目標之能力。關於這些及其他因素之額外資訊，請參閱我們向美國證券交易委員會（「SEC」）提交之文件，包括本年度 10-K 報告。所有預測性陳述僅為本報告日期之陳述。nVent Electric plc 不承擔任何義務，亦否認任何義務，更新本報告所包含之資訊。
以下為財務年度 2025 相較於財務年度 2024 之財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析。財務年度 2023 之討論與分析，以及財務年度 2024 相較於財務年度 2023 之財務狀況與營運結果之變動，未包含於本 10-K 報告中，請參閱我們於 2025 年 2 月 18 日向 SEC 提交之財務年度 2024 終結於 12 月 31 日之年度報告（Form 10-K）第 II 項第 7 項。

「我們」、「我們」、「我們」、「本公司」或「nVent」均指 nVent Electric plc。nVent 是全球領先的電氣連接與保護解決方案供應商。我們相信我們的創新電氣解決方案能提升系統安全性，並確保更安全的世界。我們連接並保護世界上最重要的電氣系統，使其更安全、更高效且更具韌性。我們設計、製造、行銷、安裝與服務高性能的產品與解決方案，用以連接並保護關鍵任務設備、建築與必要流程。我們擁有完整的產品組合，包括母線系統、電纜管理、控制建築、冷卻解決方案（液態與空氣）、電氣連接、外殼、設備保護、電力連接與電力管理解決方案，以及開關設備系統，我們在全球以品質、可靠性與創新聞名。
我們根據所提供的產品類型與服務市場，將業務運作分為業務分部。我們運作於兩個分部：系統保護與電氣連接，分別佔 2025 年總營收約 67% 與 33%。在 2025 年，我們將外殼分部更名為系統保護，並將電氣與快裝解決方案分部更名為電氣連接。
•系統保護—系統保護分部提供創新解決方案，用以保護電子設備、系統與數據於關鍵任務應用中，包括資料中心，以提升韌性與能源效率。我們的標準與客製化保護外殼、冷卻解決方案（液態與空氣）、控制建築、開關設備系統與電力分配解決方案，協助保護關鍵任務應用於基礎建設、工業與商業垂直領域之運作環境。
•電氣連接—電氣連接分部提供創新解決方案，用以連接電力與數據基礎建設。我們的產品提升終端用戶安全性、減少安裝時間並提供關鍵系統之韌性。我們的母線系統、電纜管理、電氣連接與解決方案，以及電力連接，使電氣系統更安全、更高效且更具韌性，並應用於商業與住宅、基礎建設與工業垂直領域。

2023 年 5 月 18 日，作為我們電氣連接報告分部之一部分，我們完成收購 ECM Investors, LLC，為 ECM Industries, LLC（「ECM Industries」）之母公司，以約 11 億美元現金進行。ECM Industries 是高價值電氣連接器、工具與測試儀器及電纜管理之領先供應商。購併價格主要透過 2033 年債券與 2023 年貸款融資（如後文所定義）進行資金籌措。
於 2024 年 7 月 16 日，本公司完成對 Trachte, LLC（"Trachte"）的收購，為本公司 Systems Protection 報告分部的一部分，以約 7 億美元現金進行。Trachte 是一家領先的工程控制建築解決方案製造商，專門用以保護關鍵基礎設施資產。此筆買價主要透過 2024 年定期貸款融資及循環信用融資（如下所定義）取得。

於 2025 年 1 月 30 日，本公司完成將 Thermal Management 事業出售給 BCP VI Summit Holdings LP（為 BCP Acquisitions LLC 的受讓人），為 Brookfield Asset Management 管理基金之附屬公司，以 16 億美元淨現金所得，扣除常見的買價調整後。Thermal Management 事業的結果已於本公司合併財務報表中列為已終止營運，於所有呈列期間均如此。此事業之資產與負債於合併資產負債表中於所有呈列期間均列為待出售資產，直至出售為止。Thermal Management 事業先前已揭露為獨立報告分部。如需更多細節，請參閱 ITEM 8，附註 6 之合併財務報表附註。

於 2025 年 5 月 1 日，本公司完成對 Avail Infrastructure Solutions（"Electrical Products Group"）之 enclosures、switchgear 及 bus systems 事業之收購，約 10 億美元。本公司以現金資產取得此筆買價。Electrical Products Group 是一家領先的基礎設施解決方案供應商，專門用以確保電力運作的安全與可靠，主要應用於基礎設施垂直領域，包括電力公用事業與資料中心。本公司主要於 Systems Protection 報告分部內運作 Electrical Products Group。
以下趨勢與不確定性影響本公司 2024 年與 2025 年之財務表現，並合理可能影響本公司未來之結果：

•於 2024 年與 2025 年，本公司經歷通貨膨脹性增加，主要與勞動、運輸與原物料成本相關。此外，本公司持續監測與評估最近實施之關稅，以及可能實施之修改或新增關稅。本公司可能因全球貿易政策快速變動而面臨供應鏈挑戰、通貨膨脹成本增加與經濟不確定性。2025 年新實施之關稅對本公司 2025 年財務結果之影響因緩衝措施而未達重大程度。本公司已採取價格調整措施，並可能於未來採取更多價格調整措施，並已實施、並計畫持續實施供應鏈優化及其他生產力改善措施，這些措施已幫助，且可能繼續幫助，抵消預期的成本增加。考慮到關稅及其他貿易政策變動之範圍與持續時間之不確定性，潛在影響仍不確定，但本公司預期通貨膨脹成本增加，包括與關稅相關之影響，將持續至 2026 年及以後，這可能會對本公司營運結果產生負面影響。

•本公司全球營運使本公司之有效稅率對重大稅法變動敏感。經濟合作與發展組織（Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development）已引入國際稅制架構，即 Pillar II（"Pillar II 框架"），包含 15% 之全球最低稅率。Pillar II 框架已由多個司法管轄區實施，包括本公司營運之司法管轄區，自 2024 年 1 月 1 日起生效，導致本公司有效稅率增加。各國持續宣佈根據 Pillar II 框架所進行之稅法與規則變動。雖然本公司持續評估這些立法變動之影響，待更多指引資料出現，但受影響司法管轄區之稅務當局於時間與解釋上仍存在不確定性。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
全球總體經濟與商業條件會影響我們產品的 demand（需求）。
我們在具有高度競爭的吸引人市場中競爭，這可能會對我們的毛利率造成壓力，並限制我們維持或增加產品市佔率的能力。
我們可能無法識別、籌資並完成合適的併購與投資，且任何完成的併購與投資可能失敗，或消耗大量資源。
我們可能無法實現部分或全部業務計畫預期的效益。
我們可能面臨重大成本及其他通貨膨脹。
我們製造與進口自世界各地各國的產品或材料，若其供應、價格或品質出現中斷，可能對我們的營運成果造成重大不利影響。
我們的待出貨訂單可能波動，且若出現大量取消或減少訂單，或未能及時交付待出貨訂單，可能影響我們未來的銷售表現。
本公司未來的營業收入部分取決於本公司能否成功投標並取得新契約。
本公司經營跨國業務，因而面臨政治、法規、經濟及其他相關風險。
若本公司最大客戶之一取消契約、減少或延遲購買產品，或本公司無法如期交付產品，將可能對本公司業務造成重大影響。
本公司對 subcontractors 及第三方供應商與製造商的依賴，可能對本公司造成重大不利影響。
智慧財產權的挑戰可能妨礙本公司開發、工程設計及行銷產品的能力。
本公司擁有重大商譽及無形資產，未來若發生商譽或無形資產減損，可能對本公司營運成果造成重大不利影響。
與法律、法規及合規事項相關的風險
美國及外國政府行政政策的變更，包括課徵或提高關稅及現有貿易協議的變更，可能對本公司造成重大不利影響。
違反美國外國腐敗行為防治法及美國境外或其他國際貿易合規規範之反貪污法規，可能對本公司造成重大不利影響。
本公司可能面臨潛在之環境法規、責任及訴訟風險。
本公司可能因努力避免、管理、防禦及處理智慧財產權事項而產生重大成本。
本公司可能面臨與氣候變遷及其他永續議題相關之特定法規及財務風險。
增加之網路安全威脅及電腦犯罪可能對本公司之系統、網路、產品及服務造成風險，使本公司面臨潛在之法規、財務及聲譽風險。
數據隱私權法規之變更及本公司遵守這些法規之能力，可能對本公司造成重大不利影響。
本公司可能於業務中使用人工智慧，若未能妥善管理其使用，可能導致潛在之法規、財務及聲譽風險。
本公司可能因訴訟，包括產品責任聲請，而受到負面影響。
與財務市場及我們的債務與流動性相關的風險
增加的負債可能損害我們的財務狀況及營運成果。
貨幣兌換率波動可能對我們的財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生重大不利影響。
財務市場的中斷可能對我們、我們的客戶及供應商產生不利影響，例如增加融資成本或減少信貸可得性。
我們債務工具中的約束條款可能對我們產生不利影響。
與我們在愛爾蘭設立公司及英國稅籍居住地相關的風險
我們受制於法律變更及其他因素，這些因素可能使我們無法維持一個在產業中具競爭力的全球有效企業稅率。
我們稅籍居住地的變更可能對我們未來的獲利產生負面影響，並可能引發股息稅或離境費用。
愛爾蘭法律與美國現行法律不同，可能對本公司證券持有人提供較少的保護。
愛爾蘭法律與美國現行法律不同，可能不利於本公司發行普通股的能力。
nVent 普通股的轉讓可能需課徵愛爾蘭印花稅。
透過贈與或繼承方式取得的 nVent 普通股，可能需課徵愛爾蘭資產轉讓稅。
一般風險因素
本公司股價可能出現顯著波動。
本公司之成功取決於吸引並留住合格人才。
paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱本文件內的所有資訊以及下列風險因素，再做投資決定。任何下列風險都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流以及本文件中所做之預測性陳述的實際結果產生重大且不利的影響。

我們在世界各地的各種地理區域和產品市場進行競爭。其中最重要的包括全球基礎建設、工業以及商業與住宅市場。我們預期會因經濟與商業週期而經驗收入與營運成果的波動。對我們業務及我們客戶業務而言，重要的因素包括全球經濟的整體強度與客戶對經濟的信心、工業與政府的資本支出、基礎建設與商業與住宅市場的強度、失業率、商業融資的可取得性、利率、通貨膨脹率以及能源與商品價格。我們所競爭的產業與/或市場若出現經濟衰退、經濟低迷、通貨膨脹、經濟成長放緩以及社會與政治不穩定，可能會對我們未來期間的收入與財務表現產生負面影響，導致未來重組費用，並不利於我們成長或維持業務的能力。總體經濟與政治不穩定，因全球供應鏈中斷、通貨膨脹以及美元強度所造成，可能會對我們的營運成果產生不利影響。此外，軍事衝突及其對經濟的影響也可能對我們的營運成果產生不利影響。許多我們工業客戶的業務在不同程度上具有週期性，並曾經驗過週期性低迷。雖然我們試圖透過服務一個平衡的終端市場與地理區域組合來降低對經濟或市場波動的影響，但上述任何因素，單獨或合計，或特定終端市場或地理區域的重大或持續低迷，都可能降低對我們產品與服務的需求，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流產生重大不利影響。

我們產品與服務的市場地理上多樣且競爭激烈。我們與許多大型且具規模的國家與全球公司競爭，同時也與區域性與地方性公司以及低成本製造商競爭。競爭也可能來自於進入我們所服務市場的新進企業，他們提供與我們競爭的產品與/或服務。我們的競爭優勢來自於技術專業、品質與可靠性的聲譽、交貨的及時性、過去的安裝紀錄、契約條款與價格。一些我們的競爭對手主要以價格、本地化專業知識與本地關係來競爭。此外，經濟低迷可能會因市場參與者更積極地以價格競爭而對價格產生負面影響。如果我們無法持續區隔我們的產品、服務與解決方案，或如果我們的價格受到負面影響，或我們必須承擔額外成本以維持競爭力，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流產生重大不利影響。
我們未來的成長取決於我們能否調整產品、服務與組織，以符合開發中與新興經濟體中本地市場的需求，並透過開發或取得新技術，使其獲得市場接受度且具有可接受的毛利率。
我們在具有全球性需求但本地化交付的全球市場中運作。我們與數千家較小的區域性與地方性公司競爭，這些公司可能提供成本較低的產品，或能利用高度本地化的關係。此外，在幾個新興市場中，潛在客戶傾向選擇本地供應商，有時是因為現有的關係，有時則是因為本地法律限制或鼓勵本地企業的法規。此外，我們需要靈活調整產品，以適應不斷變化的客戶偏好，包括與規範、可持續性與社會責任相關的議題。因此，我們的未來
成功取決於許多因素，包括我們能否調整產品、服務、組織、人力與銷售策略，以適應全球各地的本地情況，特別是在高成長的新興市場；識別我們目標終端市場中的新興技術與其他趨勢；以及開發或取得具有競爭力的產品與服務，並快速且成本效益地推向市場。未能有效調整我們的產品或服務，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流產生重大不利影響。
